notes: Proposed causal mutants only; no sweep or kill result is recorded here.
Runner tests entries name whole suites. Review the intended assertion in why; infrastructure/query exceptions alone are not kills.

Multiline anchors use LF and match the inspected primary source bytes. Repository .gitattributes declares text=auto eol=lf. The runner does not normalise line endings; a CRLF target must be reconciled before a sweep and must never be counted as killed when NOT-APPLIED.
The runner requires a clean committed candidate and passing unmodified/restored controls. Browser-only clipping, horizontal reachability and responsive geometry are outside this Jest manifest.

mutants.why: Intended assertion: T0191 actual Session Copy confirmation does not announce Copied while the clipboard promise is pending. Remove awaiting without introducing an unhandled rejection.
Intended assertion: T0191 Chat markdown public contract rejects unsafe or obfuscated scheme data:text/html,unsafe through both public renderers. The rendered href must fail the unsafe-scheme matcher.

Intended assertion: T0191 Chat markdown public contract Copy preserves whitespace and reports refusal=false truthfully. Clipboard payload must preserve leading/trailing whitespace and the final newline.
Intended assertion: T0191 truthful Story progress elapsed time never invents percentage or completion for pending work. The pending callback must remain uncalled.
Intended assertions: T0191 truthful Story progress hidden work cannot deliver an obsolete completion; T0191 truthful Story progress unmounted work cannot deliver an obsolete completion.

Intended assertion: T0191 actual Reader edit and continue lifecycle held edit-chapter registers a client abort, clears its overlay and rereads truth neutrally. The request signal must become aborted after Stop.

Intended assertion: T0191 actual Reader edit and continue lifecycle generate plus edit retains Stop when one settles and suppresses late reactivation after Stop. An aborted late edit must not render ready/generating feedback.
